authority: User Sensor Contract correction confirmation and S-L1A implementation/CPU/GPU canary instruction

requires: at least min_target_pixels fresh camera candidate pixels
finite positive return below LiDAR far plane
carve.anchor: minimum finite positive delivered depth on current perception candidate pixels; not tracker/LiDAR-inferred surface

cpu_oracle.geometry: independent normalized pinhole rays; slab AABB intersection; quadratic sphere intersection; no runtime sensor imports
analytic_self_checks: thin obstacle missed by coarse rays

pixel: all-pixel and robust-pixel absolute depth errors max/mean/p50/p95/p99
false-clear: observed > reference + 0.05 m on obstacle hits
false-positive: reference=no obstacle but measured < far-0.05 m
mixed-surface depths outside 0.05 m of the ray's correct surface
resources: CUDA synchronized render time after 10 warmups, 50 repeats, median and p95
GPU wall time and disk before/after
distribution: depth changed pixels and absolute deltas

gates.A-DEPTH: all robust non-target obstacle pixel absolute error <=1e-4 m; report excluded edge count; no additional false-clear or no-hit false-positive at 0.05 m threshold
gates.A-BOUNDARY: extra boundary/two-depth fixtures satisfy A-DEPTH, no interpolated fictitious surface on robust pixels
gates.A-CARVE: S14 and A_FOREGROUND actual nearer bar first-hits never removed from last_target_like/governor scan; no-camera/invalid evidence never authorizes removal; report target obstacle retention trade-off
gates.A-OFF: unset and explicit OFF all recorded digests bitwise equal; matching historical E-L0 P2 logs equal; any discrepancy stops before later processes
gates.A-EL0: ON E-L0 OFF/ON recorder toggle has identical closed-loop digests in static and moving cases
gates.A-INTEGRITY: checkpoint/RMS/898-D/import origin/source SHA/tree/raw provenance valid; no NaN/Inf
gates.A-RESOURCE: resource characterization only within watchdog/OOM/disk caps; no performance superiority claim
gates.verdict: S-L1A QUALIFIED only when A-DEPTH,A-BOUNDARY,A-CARVE,A-OFF,A-EL0,A-INTEGRITY pass; otherwise retain FAIL or INCOMPLETE. Target renderer residual and B/C/D remain separate Known FAILs.

stop: disk below 8GB before or during process
run.qualification_fail: record without retuning or retry; finish remaining independent fixtures unless integrity/noninterference failed
